_comment: Every asset is pinned by sha256; a download that does not match is discarded.
platforms is EMPTY on purpose, and that is a supported state, not an oversight:
the embedding model L3c was validated against is a local SentenceTransformer
export (pytorch 2.0.1, 'sentence_embedding' output) with no public URL to pin,
and inventing one would defeat the hash pinning this file exists for. With an
empty map, PlanFor returns ErrUnsupportedPlatform and the sidecar disables RAG
with a log line naming both ways to turn it back on.
Two ways to supply assets without editing this file:
RELEASE PROCESS TODO: to ship RAG on by default, host libonnxruntime, model.onnx
and tokenizer.json, then fill platforms with {name, path, url, sha256, size} per
os/arch key ('darwin/arm64', ...). Paths are relative to the resources dir and
must match knowledge.ResolveResourcesIn's layout: libonnxruntime.<ext> at the
root, knowledge/model.onnx and knowledge/tokenizer.json below it.
